mapper.sql: create_time, update_time, bool_delete_enum, version, id, name, report_type, inspect_type, type, product_type

select.if: SELECT distinct b.process_id id,c.`name` FROM mes_enclosure_team_user_link a LEFT JOIN mes_enclosure_team b ON a.team_id=b.id AND b.bool_delete_enum=FALSE LEFT JOIN mes_enclosure_process c ON b.process_id=c.id and c.bool_delete_enum=FALSE WHERE a.bool_delete_enum=FALSE AND a.user_id=#{userId}

SELECT distinct b.process_id id,c.`name`,c.product_type FROM mes_enclosure_inspection_team_user_link a LEFT JOIN mes_enclosure_inspection_team b ON a.inspection_team_id=b.id AND b.bool_delete_enum=FALSE LEFT JOIN mes_enclosure_process c ON b.process_id=c.id AND c.bool_delete_enum=FALSE WHERE a.bool_delete_enum=FALSE AND a.user_id=#{userId} AND c.product_type=#{taskTypeEnum}

mapper.select: SELECT process.* FROM mes_enclosure_process process WHERE process.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND process.id IN ( SELECT team.process_id FROM mes_enclosure_production_line line LEFT JOIN mes_enclosure_groups gro ON gro.production_line_id = line.id AND gro.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN mes_enclosure_groups_team_link link ON link.groups_id = gro.id AND link.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN mes_enclosure_team team ON team.id = link.team_id AND team.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE line.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND line.id = #{productionLineId} )

SELECT process.* FROM mes_enclosure_process process WHERE process.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND process.id IN ( SELECT team.process_id FROM mes_enclosure_workshop workshop LEFT JOIN mes_enclosure_production_line line ON line.workshop_id = workshop.id LEFT JOIN mes_enclosure_groups gro ON gro.production_line_id = line.id AND gro.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN mes_enclosure_groups_team_link link ON link.groups_id = gro.id AND link.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN mes_enclosure_team team ON team.id = link.team_id AND team.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE workshop.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND workshop.id = #{workshopId}) ORDER BY process.product_type ASC, process.sort ASC
